sloka: अन्यैः च रत्नैः बहुभिः काकुत्स्थः प्रत्यपूजयत् ।सुयज्ञम् स तदा उवाच रामः सीता प्रचोदितः ॥२-३२-६॥
transliteration: anyaiḥ ca ratnaiḥ bahubhiḥ kākutsthaḥ pratyapūjayat ।suyajñam sa tadā uvāca rāmaḥ sītā pracoditaḥ ॥2-32-6॥

translations.english: Rama, scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, worshipped Suyajna with a collection of golden ornaments such as earrings, anklets, armlets, bracelets and many other ornaments of precious stones. Then urged by Sita, Rama said to him:
translations.hindi: कोई कहता--देखो जिसके पीछे, यात्रा करते समय, चतु- रङ्गिणी सेना चलती थी, उसके पीछे (आज ) केबल सीता ओर लक्ष्मण ही है
